beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Paris exposes the technical production of legitimacy through calendar inclusion, monumental rooms, official images, digital programmes, showrooms and archives. This chapter follows commerce: Between runway attention and an order sit identifiers, line sheets, showrooms, buyer permissions and product records whose adoption is often claimed faster than it is proved.
beats.onScreen: Then: Regulation (EU) 2024/1781 establishes an ecodesign framework that includes digital product passports and applies through later product-specific requirements.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: Regulation (EU) 2024/1781 establishes an ecodesign framework that includes digital product passports and applies through later product-specific requirements. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: The EU textile strategy anticipates product-passport information for textiles; neither record proves every Paris runway look currently carries a passport.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: Textile-specific delegated rules, data fields and dates must be tracked through official EU records; no FHCM implementation is asserted.
